examples.title: Label and helper text
examples.description: A visible label names the textarea. Helper copy is linked through `aria-describedby`.

examples.title: Sizes
examples.description: Compact, default and large text share the same native row count.

examples.title: Controlled value
examples.description: Own the value through `onChange`. Resetting the value also updates the counter.

examples.title: Hard and soft limits
examples.description: The default hard limit uses native `maxLength`. `enforceMaxLength={false}` keeps editing available; validate overflow in your form.

examples.title: Validation feedback
examples.description: Helper and error rows ease into place. Errors keep their existing IDs and announcement semantics.

examples.title: Form library invalid state
examples.description: `aria-invalid="true"` gives the red border without an error prop. A form-owned message can supply its own description.

examples.title: Disabled and read-only
examples.description: Disabled fields leave the tab order. Read-only text stays selectable, focusable and available to forms.

examples.title: Native resizing
examples.description: `rows` defaults to four and `resize` to none. Enable a native vertical resize handle when your layout allows it.

examples.title: Auto resize
examples.description: Opt into content-based height with `autoResize`. `minRows` and `maxRows` bound the height; longer content scrolls. Existing sizing defaults stay unchanged.

examples.title: Spaces and line breaks
examples.description: Repeated U+0020 spaces collapse to one. Single leading/trailing spaces, tabs and line breaks count and remain intact. IME drafts stay untouched until commit.

examples.title: Native form submission
examples.description: `name`, `required` and `minLength` work with native forms. This example shows the local `FormData` value after submission.
